mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates for equity valuation and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 207.5, it signals elevated inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 207.5), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% and the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 207.5, the combination signals a monetary tightening cycle with high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>5.0 AND CPIAUCSL>207.5) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 20d returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500, the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, which is characterized by overvaluation and rising interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle regime (UNRATE<4.0 AND HOUST>1500) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the regime effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive equity market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and economic growth, which is associated with positive equity returns over the medium term, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which is associated with positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 3.5), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals a slowdown in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness and negative equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
